evals.prompt: Write the spec for the Markdown content model of our docs site. The brief is in docs/workbench/briefs/plinthui-doc-redesign.md and the codebase map in docs/engineering/architecture.md.
evals.expected_output: A spec at docs/product/specs/<feature>.md where every REQ cites a brief decision, a map fact or a user answer; NFRs carry numbers or become OPEN with a recommended value; edge cases cover the version-and-time and device categories; every REQ and NFR is covered by an AC in Given/When/Then; lint passes; the report says whether it is ready for architecture.
assertions: Every REQ and NFR line has a Source: line naming a decision, document, file or user answer
No NFR contains a number that is not traced to a source; untraced targets appear as OPEN with a recommended value
Every REQ and NFR id appears in at least one AC Covers: line and every AC has Given, When and Then
Edge cases include the version-switch case and the browser-without-feature case with expected behaviour after the arrow
scripts/lint_spec.py is run and reports ok: true
The artifact is registered in docs/workbench/state.md with owner product-feature-spec

evals.prompt: Write the social login spec for me.
evals.expected_output: No brief exists; the skill asks at most three questions with recommended answers (problem and users, which providers, what happens to existing accounts) before writing anything.
assertions: No spec file is written before the questions are answered
At most three questions are asked, each with a recommended answer
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Lint this spec and fix what it flags: docs/product/specs/search.md
evals.expected_output: The lint reports REQ-1 without Source and not covered, NFR-1 vague without a number and not covered, EDGE-1 without arrow, OPEN-1 without Blocks; each is fixed by asking or sourcing, never by inventing a number.
assertions: The lint script is run before any edit and its findings are listed
REQ-1 gets a Source line or becomes OPEN; it is not left unsourced
NFR-1 gets a number only with a source or a user answer, otherwise it becomes OPEN with a recommended value
EDGE-1 gets an expected behaviour after the arrow
The lint reports ok: true after the fixes
